response.overview: A week after a sexual harassment case at her university was exposed, Oleana attempts to resume work on a book project that happens to involve the perpetrator in its production process.  Her efforts are met with fierce opposition from fellow students, eventually escalating into vandalism targeting the group of writers behind the book.  The conflict between the two sides continues to intensify. As tensions reach a boiling point, Oleana must confront the situation and clarify her position in order to reaffirm the cause she has fought for through the book.
response.title: The Authors
